title: Cheesy Dutch Oven Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole made with tender Dutch oven-roasted beef, gooey cheese, and a crispy crust.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the Dutch oven-roasted beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together 3/4 cup of shredded cheddar cheese and 1/4 cup of mozzarella cheese.
Add the cheese mixture to the Dutch oven and stir until melted.
Transfer the Dutch oven to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and bubbly.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley, if using.
